basic_info.description: Upon entering this elegant home on a tree lined street, you are greeted by a gracious & spacious foyer leading to a grand formal living room with outlooks of Laguna Honda & green hills. The space is perfect for hosting intimate gatherings or enjoying quiet evenings by the fireplace. On the opposite side of the foyer is a formal dining room which exudes an air of refinement, setting the stage for memorable dinners. The eat-in kitchen features ample space for casual dining & culinary creativity. The residence boasts four spacious bedrooms on the top floor including a primary bedroom & en suite bathroom.  One of the bedrooms features an enclosed sun room perfect for reading a book or enjoying a cup of coffee. There is an additional full bathroom on this floor. The lower level is a versatile haven, complete with a full bedroom, bathroom, family room, & den. This space is ideal for accommodating an au pair or creating a private retreat for extended family. Additional storage & a one car garage complete this lovely home. The home's elegant architecture and thoughtful design make it a true gem in Forest Hill. The home is close to the shops on Irving as well as West Portal Village. Also conveniently located to the Forest Hill Muni station and public transportation.
